Notification types
Session Start & End Alerts
Notify when a scheduled study part begins and when it ends (with Next Up info and direct link to Tasks)
5-Minute Unchecked Part Reminder
Remind 5 minutes after a part ends if not checked off — tap to check it off in Tasks or jump to Carry-Over to reschedule/skip
Daily Good Morning & Good Night
Good Morning at 08:00 on Thursdays & Fridays (06:00 on other days) and Good Night at 00:00 midnight
Weekly & Monthly Review Nudge
On the first day of a new week or month, nudge you to check last period’s report and plan the new week — repeats until both are done
